Scientists Warn 96% of Coral Reefs Face Collapse by 2075

Scientists have warned that 96% of the world's coral reef ecosystems are at critical risk of collapse by 2075, within the next 50 years. The primary drivers identified for this potential collapse are emissions and pollution. This assessment indicates that nearly all coral reefs are endangered.
